en:
Everyone, you have to believe me!
Shuichi is not the culprit!

If we vote for Shuichi, we'll be making the
wrong choice!

And if that happens...
Everyone will be executed...

I definitely won't let that happen, even if it
costs me my life!
Kaede...

Yeah, it's just like Kaede said!
Shuichi ain't the culprit!

Gonta believe in Shuichi, too!
Gentlemen always believe in friends!

Well, if Shuichi's not our 
culprit...then who is?

We've already exhausted all
possible avenues of discussion...

No way. There has to be something else 
we can discuss. We just gotta think.
Right, Shuichi?
Huh?

Shuichi...even though you're not the culprit,
you've been quiet for a while...
It's because you realized something, huh?
You're scared to reveal the <CLT=cltSTRONG>truth<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
I thought so...
Shuichi...

Answer me this—what <CLT=cltSTRONG>kind of truth<CLT=cltNORMAL> did you
realize?

Don't be scared to say it.
Not just for me...but for everyone else.
Please...face the truth.
...The <CLT=cltSTRONG>picture<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
...Picture?

The picture from the camera aimed at
the hidden door, just before the murder.

I always thought it was suspicious...
The way Rantaro was acting...
Hm? What's suspicious?

If you look at the picture, it looks like
Rantaro is trying to <CLT=cltSTRONG>remove the camera<CLT=cltNORMAL>...

But that must mean he <CLT=cltSTRONG>noticed<CLT=cltNORMAL> the camera
we set up.

That's true.
But when did he notice that?

I believe it was when the camera
took its <CLT=cltSTRONG>first picture<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

This picture was taken when Rantaro
moved the bookcase.

At that moment, <CLT=cltSTRONG>something<CLT=cltNORMAL> made him notice the
camera.

So, he tried to remove it, and that's when
the bookcase closed.

The sensor was triggered, and that's when this
picture was taken.

If that is the case, we must find the reason
why he noticed the camera.

You're confusin' everyone! Except me, of
course! Just get to the fuckin' point!

I've been contemplating what it could be.
Why did he notice the camera?
And the answer...is in this picture.
<CLT=cltMIND>I see... Shuichi knows...
Rear entrance camera

Is it because he noticed the camera placed
near the rear entrance?

No, I don't think he noticed that
particular camera...

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
They all think less of me now...<CLT=cltNORMAL>
Bookcase sensor

Is it because he noticed the sensor placed 
on the bookcase?

No, he shouldn't have noticed the
security sensor. The key is the camera...

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
They all think less of me now...<CLT=cltNORMAL>
The camera flash
Umm...

What's wrong? If you got somethin' to say,
just spit it out! Or swallow it, I don't care!

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
They all think less of me now...<CLT=cltNORMAL>

<CLT=cltMIND>The reason why Rantaro noticed the 
camera was because...
Because of the <CLT=cltSTRONG>flash<CLT=cltNORMAL>, right?
Nyeh? The flash?

Yes. The flash went off when the hidden door
camera took a picture.
Rantaro noticed the camera's flash.
But how can you tell the flash went off?

Well, if you compare it to the
other pictures that we have...

Remember the pictures that were
taken when I took down the cameras?

This is the picture taken when I
removed the front camera...

And this is the picture from
when I removed the rear camera.
And this...is the picture of Rantaro.

Whoa! The <CLT=cltSTRONG>brightness<CLT=cltNORMAL> is
totally different!

Same room, circumstance, and camera.
And yet, there is a disparity in brightness...

Because only the camera aimed at the
hidden door had the <CLT=cltSTRONG>flash turned on<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

What was the purpose of leaving the flash on? 
Especially since it was meant to be hidden...
A mistake, maybe?
It's no mistake. There was an objective here.

That camera was placed
for another reason.
Another reason, huh?
To take a picture of the mastermind

<CLT=cltMIND>...No, the flash wouldn't have been necessary
to take the mastermind's photo.

<CLT=cltMIND>Come on... I need to face the truth!
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
To light up the room

<CLT=cltMIND>There would be no point in lighting up the
room if we weren't there.

<CLT=cltMIND>Come on... I need to face the truth!
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
To lure the mastermind closer
To blind the mastermind
<CLT=cltMIND>There would be no point in blinding them.

<CLT=cltMIND>Come on... I need to face the truth!
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
What was this other reason, Shuichi?
Well, it's...
<CLT=cltMIND>...<CLT=cltNORMAL>

<CLT=cltMIND>I know this. There's only one reason
the camera's flash was used...

The flash was used to <CLT=cltSTRONG>lure<CLT=cltNORMAL> whoever
moved the bookcase to the camera.

So when the flash went off, they would
have noticed the camera right away.
And that's exactly what happened.

Rantaro moved the bookcase, noticed the
flash, and then walked over to the camera.

But the culprit didn't expect the camera to
take another picture when the door closed.
Hey, Kaede...?
What is it?

Is...something wrong?
You've been acting...kinda strange.
...Strange?

Your last few remarks carry...
more conviction than before.
Do you know who the culprit is!?

Yup, I know.
I've known for a long time.
...Hm? Long time?

Because there was only <CLT=cltSTRONG>one person<CLT=cltNORMAL>
able to set the flash on the camera.
Isn't that right, Shuichi?
The culprit of this incident is...
Kaede... I...

...It's okay. I know you're not the culprit,
Shuichi.
...It's alright. I know.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's okay. You just need to calm down...and
say it.
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
Kaede...

<CLT=cltMIND>It's okay. You just need to calm down...and
say it.
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
...No, that's wrong. I'm sorry.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's okay. You just need to calm down...and
say it.
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
Who killed Rantaro?
<CLT=cltMIND>...
<CLT=cltMIND>...
<CLT=cltMIND>Well, this is as far as it goes...

<CLT=cltMIND>I couldn't do it.
I couldn't get to the mastermind.
<CLT=cltMIND>I'm sorry...everyone.
<CLT=cltMIND>I'm sorry...Rantaro.
<CLT=cltMIND>I'm sorry...Shuichi.

<CLT=cltMIND>You stayed silent this whole time because
you realized it already, right?
<CLT=cltMIND>But, you can't do that.

<CLT=cltMIND>It may be the end of me, but I want
my <CLT=cltSTRONG>wish<CLT=cltMIND> to...
<CLT=cltMIND>I'm giving it to you, Shuichi.

<CLT=cltMIND>From now on, you're going to carry on my 
wish! You're going to protect everyone!<CLT=cltNORMAL>
<CLT=cltMIND>Kaede...I know what you want me to do...
<CLT=cltMIND>That's so cruel...
<CLT=cltMIND>It's cruel, but...
<CLT=cltMIND>...
<CLT=cltMIND>...I understand. I'll do it.
<CLT=cltMIND>You can trust me.
<CLT=cltMIND>I won't let your <CLT=cltSTRONG>wish<CLT=cltMIND>...
<CLT=cltMIND>...go ungranted.<CLT=cltNORMAL>
